info.title: vWii Compat Title Installer
info.author: DaThinkingChair
info.description: Install the Homebrew Channel to the vWii
info.details:
Install a channel to the vWii Menu from Wii U Mode. In its current state, it simply installs the Homebrew Channel.

Credits to:

Dimok, smealum, others for iosuhax and Mocha CFW.
FIX94, this repo is largely based off of wuphax.
@Ingunar on GitHub, for the awesome icons
TheLordScruffy/mkwcat, for the original Compat Title Installer

changelog:
v2.0
Credits to @zer00p for this release, changelog:
- Add wad install functionality
- d2x cios download and install
- IOS80 Patcher
- usbloader gx + Forwarder Channel + Aroma Forwarder
- Homebrew Browser / LibreShop download
- Express Install / Uninstall for everything above
- Reinstall option for system titles (should be a more convenient replacement for the decaffinator, since it doesn't run into problems with the update block)
- (Experimental) Drive Inquiry Patch for the most common IOSes (the one from Gary, so the vWii is usable without disc drive)

1.6

Only align buffers to 0x40, not its size
